steps.content:
10:30 AM
Unspecified date, N.F. 115
The MBCC's hallway

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hey there! Looking for Chief? He just finished the morning meeting. Should be taking a break in his office now.
steps.female_content: Hey there! Looking for Chief? She just finished the morning meeting. Should be taking a break in her office now.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Yeah, Chief left the comms terminal at the cafeteria.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Huh... Never thought Chief could be so forgetful too... Come to think of it, he hasn't been looking well lately. Always nodding off too. Wonder if he's not getting enough sleep at night?
steps.female_content: Huh... Never thought Chief could be so forgetful too... Come to think of it, she hasn't been looking well lately. Always nodding off too. Wonder if she's not getting enough sleep at night?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Pulling all-nighters playing video games? Or maybe binging TV shows...?

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Look who's talking...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What are you chatting about?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Adjutant Nightingale! We were just talking about Chief. He hasn't been looking well lately... Should we get him some health supplements?
steps.female_content: Adjutant Nightingale! We were just talking about Chief. She hasn't been looking well lately... Should we get her some health supplements?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I kept count during the morning meeting. He yawned exactly nineteen times, spaced out twice, and even signed the documents in the wrong places.
steps.female_content: I kept count during the morning meeting. She yawned exactly nineteen times, spaced out twice, and even signed the documents in the wrong places.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: —And left the terminal at breakfast.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I understand. I'll take care of the device. You two can return to your duties. Chief's been having some rough days lately, so I've already scheduled a medical check-up for him.
steps.female_content: I understand. I'll take care of the device. You two can return to your duties. Chief's been having some rough days lately, so I've already scheduled a medical check-up for her.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: As for whether supplements or sick leave are needed, let's leave that decision to the doctor.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Always so trustworthy, Adjutant! In that case, we'll leave Chief and his device in your capable hands. See you later!
steps.female_content: Always so trustworthy, Adjutant! In that case, we'll leave Chief and her device in your capable hands. See you later!

steps.content: Wynn tugs Eugene along as they leave the hallway.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, I'm coming in.
As Nightingale opens the door, she finds ${PlayerName} resting at the desk with closed eyes, faint dark circles visible beneath them.
She places the device on the desk and, before leaving, takes a moment to examine the wisteria branch on it.
After quelling the calamity of the frantically growing wisteria that winter night, Chief brought back a branch taken from the Mania-infected plant.
Now planted in a pot on the desk, the once greyish, withered branch has sprouted several delicate new buds. Fresh crystal-clear droplets of water adorn the tips of the leaves like tiny jewels.
...It's still emanating a faint trace of Mania.
Meanwhile...

You've been treading through this misty dreamscape for a while now, and this time the journey feels especially long. Roughly the distance between the MBCC and the remains of that Mania-infected wisteria, you estimate.
Leading you forward, drawing you onward, is a single wisteria flower drifting gently before your eyes.
[Scene: Under the Wisteria Tree]

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You've come to see me again, sweetheart.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Did you notice this place has grown bigger on your way here?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I was getting bored here, so I tried recreating DisCity, just the way you described it to me.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Building it all up piece by piece takes quite some time, you know.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Not at all! I've been keeping myself busy, building this place while imagining all your heroic adventures here and there... Hehe, it's been quite entertaining.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once you're better, we'll go see the real thing.
You pause thoughtfully, roll up your sleeve, and extend your hand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since I'm here, don't you want an extra helping?
This is a tacit agreement between you two.

Ever since the Wisteria incident, Yingying's physical body remains trapped in the Mania-contaminated ruins, unable to fully withdraw from it. She's extremely weak, kept alive only by Wuhuanzi's treatment and the stabilization equipment, yet unable to truly recover.

You brought that delicate sprout back to the Bureau, but that only allows you to meet her in dreams for brief chats. In these dreams, she claims she's getting better day by day, but you always wake up to the same reports showing no progress.

After some time, you finally turned to the unorthodox remedy from the story: transferring your own Qi—your vital energy—to heal her. It's such a reckless attempt, so you can only do it without anyone knowing.
After all, a connection has formed between the two of you through the shackles. Giving her a little of your energy each day seems to be working.
But the progress is painfully slow, so slow it fills you with anxiety.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Here, my dear Wisteria Fairy. Your faithful devotee has come with offerings.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I have dear Wuhuanzi looking after me, so there's no need.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: She comes often to treat the wisteria with acupuncture, and she tells me everything, like how her friend ${PlayerName} has been dozing off and tripping over things all day.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I'm afraid we may lose your life before saving mine... Heh...
Yingying gives you a playful glare, then reaches out to poke your face petulantly.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I've told you. You need to stop it if you begin to feel unwell. Did you think you could fool me?
You try to speak, but her words cut you off.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I know, that you only need to rest for a few days, that my recovery is more important, blah blah.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: But you're important to me too.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So, let's try something different today.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I've been watching Wuhuanzi work and learned some authentic Eastian massage technique. It's great for relaxing muscles and improving circulation! Let me help restore your health! Consider it a thank you for giving me your Qi!
As she speaks, she flexes her wrists with determined enthusiasm.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You've shared so much of your Qi with me. It's about time I return the favor.

options: Wuhuanzi gives massages to trees too?

choices.text: Wuhuanzi gives massages to trees too?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Come on now, sweetheart. Let's begin~

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Uh-uh, it won't be as effective if I'm gentle!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Leave it to me. Just sit back... and enjoy yourself.
[Black Screen]
Yingying guides you to lie down on a carpet of wisteria blossoms under the tree. As you settle in, the accumulated fatigue washes over you like waves.
Each time you visit Yingying, you transfer most of your Qi to her. Despite Wuhuanzi's repeated warnings, you believe you can handle it.
But as soon as you lie down, every muscle and joint in your body screams in protest.
Several wisteria petals drift down onto your eyelids, tinting your vision with a dreamy shade of purple.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Here I go, then!
Her fingers glide up your cheeks, tap gently between your eyebrows, then slide to the back of your head.
Her movements are gentle yet precise. When she presses down on the pressure points, instead of pain, you feel an indescribable tingling sensation.
Before you know it, your entire body melts into relaxation.
So gentle...
Such warmth...
The touch of her wandering fingers grows bolder. From your scalp to your shoulders, then down your back, to your waist, and...
Wherever her fingers pass, a gentle warmth flows from her fingertips into your body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait!
Your body feels weightless.
As familiar energy flows from her fingertips, your Qi rapidly returns.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hold on...
[End black screen]
You sit bolt upright and grab Yingying's hand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you returning the Qi to me?
In response to your question, she just interlaces her fingers with yours, then pushes you back down onto the wisteria blossoms.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Cause you can't take care of yourself, so I'll just have to do it instead.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: A certain someone thinks he should—and can—shoulder every responsibility alone. But he only ends up burning himself out without even realizing it, hurting those who care about him too.
steps.female_content: A certain someone thinks she could—and can—shoulder every responsibility alone. But she only ends up burning herself out without even realizing it, hurting those who care about her too.

steps.content: She reaches out, a single wisteria blossom pinched delicately between her fingertips.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Look, the wisteria is sprouting new buds. I'm just like these plants. All I need is some water and sunlight to thrive. There's nothing wrong with taking things slow, so why insist on making me the wicked spirit who drains all life and energy out of you?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: If you really collapse because of me, I'd lose my favorite partner, and everyone at that "Noms" would never forgive me.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So... be a dear and stay put. Today is your designated recovery day.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Phhh...
[CG or Close-up Shot: Wisteria Tree]
With her gentle breath, the wisteria buds burst into bloom all at once, cascading down like a purple waterfall to envelop the two of you in their embrace.

With the earth as your bed and the wisteria as your canopy, under a shower of falling purple petals, the beauty takes advantage of your distraction to lean in close and plant a sly kiss on the tip of your nose.
Your anger melts away in an instant. It's simply impossible to stay mad at her.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I'm not that fragile! Three days of sleep is all I need. It's nothing compared to what you're putting yourself through.
She gently rests her head on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Thank you, sweetheart. Even with how busy you are, you still remember to water my flowers, come visit me, and even share your Qi with me. That alone makes me so happy.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Please, at least let me do something for you in return.

options: But that'd mean delaying your recovery indefinitely.

choices.text: But that'd mean delaying your recovery indefinitely.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Aha, here we go again! What's the rush? Is it the Eastian scholar? Or your Paradeisos boss? Are they that desperate to wake me up to question me?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Well, there are rules to these things, you know. In the old tale, when the spirit's soul and form are completely destroyed, it takes centuries or even a millennium to recover. I'd say I'm making quite good progress in comparison.
Her delicate, porcelain-like fingers poke at your cheek twice coyly.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: If I were really to rely on that frail body of yours, that tiny bit of Qi you share wouldn't even help me sprout. No, no, I'd have to grow my own, drawing strength from nature itself.

steps.speaker: Option A
options: So you actually think you can photosynthesize?

choices.text: So you actually think you can photosynthesize?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I go to the gym every day now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not a vegetable, you know. A human's Qi is what you need to heal, so just take it from me. It's not like I'm giving you permission to harm others.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're going to be so picky about it... I'll work out more to build up my strength, okay? That should satisfy you, right?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Where would you even find the time? You're already losing sleep because of me, drowning in work... I get exhausted just looking at you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Things are just fine now. Even though I often have to wait, your visits always make my day.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: In this little world of ours, it's just you and me. No one to disturb us, we can stay as long as we like. Isn't it wonderful?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I don't mind if we stay this way forever. It's like our own romantic fairy tale, hehe.
She's always smiling when she makes these playful remarks, but that faint detachment behind her cheerful words is never lost on you.

Ever since the fete ended, she's grown much quieter. Despite how eager you are for her recovery, Yingying doesn't seem to care about it herself. Perhaps she's concerned for your health, or is still not used to this new world a century later, or perhaps...
She only chose to stay to please you, to fulfill your wish... Could it be that she never truly wanted this herself?
You can't utter these exact words. Like her, you can only keep smiling, concealing your careful questions within playful banter.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm thinking of something more fun. Once you've recovered, shall I take you for a walk through the real streets of DisCity? Seeing you're so keen on it that you're building your own version of it in this world.
Her face lights up with surprise and anticipation, but you can tell she's only putting on this smile to please you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've already submitted a formal request to the Eastian delegation. They'll look into ways to speed up your recovery, to help you break free from your current state as soon as possible.
She claps her hands in gratitude for your efforts, but her eyes betray no real enthusiasm for the prospect.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you recover soon, maybe next year we could organize another fete in DisCity together? We could invite all our familiar faces from last year.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hmm?!
For the first time, Yingying's eyes glisten with genuine interest, but she immediately shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: What am I, a child you can sweet-talk? I won't fall for your tricks! Now shoo, shoo! You've been lounging around here long enough. Time for you to go, and I need my beauty sleep too!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: If you show up looking this haggard again next time, I won't let you in! Off you go!
[Scene transition: Chief's Office]
You jolt awake, suddenly torn from your peaceful reverie.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I woke up? No, wait... I got kicked out, didn't I?
Beep-beep...

Your communication device rings urgently. As you reach to answer it, your eyes fall on the wisteria branch on your desk. The dew on the tender green leaves is gone, and the waves of Mania have grown extremely faint.
A tingling sensation still lingers where Yingying touched you, confirming that wasn't just a dream.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sorry, Chief. I didn't mean to wake you from your nap.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, actually, I got kicked out. Don't worry about it.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. Chief, there's also a meeting request from the Eastian Embassy that requires your attention.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: They'd like to meet you personally. They seem very serious about it. Apparently, it concerns Yingying... and her fete.
